sunoData.title: Ashen Relic Hall
sunoData.tags: Ambient game soundtrack with slow-evolving pulses and airy modal drones, designed for forgotten temples and puzzle archaeology spaces; verse-like sections become sparse with bowed textures and distant frame-drum taps, then widen into a more luminous midsection with glassy chimes and low choir haze before receding into near-silence. Add reversed bell swells, stone-room echoes, subtle granular dust, and soft transition risers. Wide, ancient, and cinematic with a polished but restrained mix., ambient
